prompt: `sum_array` runs with `rdi` pointing at `{10, 20, 30}` and `rsi = 3`. Follow the loop.
code:
xor eax, eax
xor ecx, ecx
.Lloop:
cmp rcx, rsi
jae .Ldone
add rax, [rdi + rcx*8]
inc rcx
jmp .Lloop
.Ldone:
ret

trace.label: [offset] bytes from `rdi` read by the third `add` (rcx = 2)

explain: The `*8` scales the index by the element size, so element 2 is 16 bytes past `rdi`. The loop stops when `rcx` reaches `rsi` (unsigned compare), which also makes `n = 0` skip the body without touching memory. 10 + 20 + 30 = 60.
